data.text:
South East Asia - my recommended places to visit

Over the last few years I have traveled a lot across South East Asia. I also worked in Singapore for one year, which made the travel easier. Based on my personal experiences, these are the places I would recommend depending on what you look for:

1. Beaches: Palawan (Philippines), Krabi (Thailand), and Bali (Indonesia). Bali is also great for longer-term stays and remote work.
2. Temples: Angkor Wat (Cambodia) is unmissable. Bagan (Myanmar) is stunning but not possible to visit now due to the political situation.
3. Modern cities: Singapore, Bangkok, Ho Chi Minh, and Kuala Lumpur — cities where I can imagine myself living.
4. Nature: Ha Long Bay (Vietnam) for island hopping, Sa Pa (Vietnam) for rice terraces and mountains, Mount Bromo (Indonesia) for volcanoes.
5. Unusual experiences: Swim with whale sharks in Cebu (Philippines). Walk the Vietnam war tunnels in Ho Chi Minh. Kawah Ijen (Indonesia) for an active volcano and blue fire.

#SoutheastAsia #Travel

media.ext_alt_text: This image shows safety tips for driving in dust storms, presented on a hazy background of a road with low visibility. The tips are: 1. Pull off the road as far as possible. 2. Stop and turn off all lights. 3. Set the emergency brake. 4. Take your foot off the brake, make sure taillights are not illuminated. Other drivers may try to follow them and could crash into your vehicle. 5. Do not get out of your vehicle. 6. Keep your seatbelt on. The lower right displays the Arizona Department of Transportation logo.
